reviews.comment: One of the sweetest and most understanding professors I have ever had. I did not speak during class discussions, but I was still engaged because she was so funny and bubbly. Take her if you can, I am going to miss her class!

Anyone who rates professor Wierenga low simply did not show up to class. I'm a senior and she is one of the best, most understanding profs I've had. If you communicate with her, she will be understanding. Her class is reading heavy but they're children's books, as long as you show up to class you should have no problem making an A or B.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor W is a really nice teacher. As long as you do your reading, it's not a difficult class. Her slides are easy to follow and well presented. She likes to do small group activities and classroom discussions, and she encourages everyone to participate. She grades fairly, so long as you read the syllabus and follow directions you'll do fine.

Show up and participate, you must read in order to do so but they are children's books so it's not hard at all. Put in the effort to show up every day and put a little extra effort into writing decent papers and you have the formula for an A. You can find most of the books online, don't waste your money.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Assigns papers over spring break. Like, rough draft due the Friday before, peer review due that Sunday, and final paper due the MONDAY WE GET BACK. So basically forcing her students to work on this assignment and have to stress about it instead of maybe getting to relax after midterms. Harshest grader I've had even though it's a core english class.
